archetypes.name: Insane-looking act, real mechanism
humour_devices: literal visual of figures of speech
exaggeration simile ('lost a race to the milk cart')

archetypes.name: Second-person what-if with a moral choice
humour_devices: dry asides ('unless someone trips over the power cable')
emotional_curve: the choice is handed to the viewer

why_it_works: The viewer is shown an act that looks stupid, watches everyone mock it, and gets proved wrong with a real mechanism they can repeat to a friend. Surprise, plus schadenfreude, plus a fact you can retell.
